facebook.content:
My dear family, 

I see you. I see your struggles, I see your fears, and I see your faith. And I want you to know that you're not alone. You're not just a number, you're not just a face in the crowd. You're a child of the Most High God, and He has a plan to prosper you.

You don't have to be controlled by your circumstances. You don't have to be defeated by your doubts. You are more than a conqueror through Christ, and I want to remind you of that today.
